info.title: Studio Suite API
info.description:
Backend of **go-react-business-suite**, a reference/sample project (NOT a production product): service catalog, customers, appointments on a single agenda, and a results dashboard for a small fictional studio.

- **Auth:** `POST /v1/auth/login` returns a short-lived JWT (`Authorization: Bearer ...`) and a single-use refresh token. Roles: `admin`, `staff`.
- **Errors:** RFC 9457 `application/problem+json` with a stable `code` and, for validation, a per-field `errors` list.
- **Money** is an integer number of cents. **Instants** are RFC 3339 UTC; **calendar days** (filters, dashboard) are `YYYY-MM-DD` in the business time zone.
- **Pagination:** `page` (1-based) + `page_size` (max 100); lists answer `{data, page, page_size, total}`.
- **CORS** is configured by `CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS`; in production nginx serves the frontend and proxies `/api` here (this document describes the API paths as the service sees them, without the `/api` prefix).

post.description: Refresh tokens are single use. Presenting an already-used one is treated as theft: every refresh token of that user is revoked. Rate limited per client IP.

post.description: Always 204. The access token stays valid until it expires (15 minutes by default); drop it on the client.

post.description: The single agenda cannot hold overlapping appointments; this is enforced atomically by the database, so of N simultaneous requests for one slot exactly one succeeds and the rest get 409.

Id.name: id
Id.description: Resource id. A malformed id answers 404, like an unknown one.

Query.name: q
Query.description: Case-insensitive substring search (literal text; `%` and `_` have no special meaning).

From.name: from
From.description: First day, inclusive, `YYYY-MM-DD` in the business time zone.

To.name: to
To.description: Last day, inclusive. `from`..`to` may span at most 366 days.

BadRequest.description: The body is not valid JSON for this endpoint (`invalid_json`).

Unauthorized.description: Missing or invalid access token (`missing_token`, `invalid_token`); on login/refresh: `invalid_credentials` / `invalid_token`.

Forbidden.description: The role is not allowed to do this (`forbidden`): admin only.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a request is allowed again.

InternalError.description: Unexpected error (`internal_error`); the cause is logged, never returned. Quote `request_id`.

Unavailable.description: The request exceeded its time budget (`timeout`) or a dependency is down (`not_ready`).

field.description: Name of the offending field (dotted for nested ones).

type.description: Always `about:blank`: the HTTP status says it all; branch on `code`.

errors.description: Present on `validation_failed` (422): one entry per invalid field.

Role.description: `admin` can also delete services/customers and create users; `staff` cannot remove anything.

access_token.description: JWT (HS256), valid for `expires_in` seconds. Send as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

refresh_token.description: Opaque, single use: every refresh returns a NEW pair and invalidates this token. Reusing an old one revokes all the user's sessions.

ServicePatch.description: Partial update: send only the fields to change. Editing price/duration never alters existing appointments (they hold a snapshot).

phone.description: Optional; 10 to 13 digits, formatting characters are accepted and stripped.

CustomerPatch.description: Partial update: send only the fields to change.

customer_name.description: Current name of the customer (read-model field).

service_name.description: SNAPSHOT of the service name at booking time.

starts_at.description: UTC instant. Show it in the business time zone (`timezone` in dashboard responses).

ends_at.description: `starts_at` + `duration_min`. Intervals are half-open: back-to-back appointments do not conflict.

duration_min.description: SNAPSHOT of the service duration at booking time.

price_cents.description: SNAPSHOT of the service price at booking time.

starts_at.description: RFC 3339, must be in the future. Any offset is accepted; it is stored as UTC.

status.description: Target status: `completed`, `no_show` (only once the appointment has started) or `cancelled`.

appointments_total.description: All appointments that START in the period, any status.

revenue_cents.description: REALIZED revenue: sum of the frozen prices of `completed` appointments.

average_ticket_cents.description: revenue_cents / completed, rounded to the cent (0 when there are none).

cancellation_rate.description: cancelled / appointments_total, 0..1, 4 decimals (0 when there are none).

no_show_rate.description: no_show / appointments_total, 0..1, 4 decimals (0 when there are none).

data.description: One point per calendar day of the period, zero-filled (no holes), ascending.
